title: Internal Hom chart equivalence preserves terminal evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M and F arbitrary modules, U an affine open and hU its affine chart. The constructed chartHomEquiv identifies sections of internal Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom] over U with morphisms on Spec Γ(X,U). The chartSectionsEquiv maps identify chart sections with original sections as Γ(X,U)-modules. Conjugating the global-sections linear map of chartHomEquiv(φ) by these section equivalences equals the terminal component φ.app(op(Over.mk(𝟙 U))). No quasi-coherence or finite-presentation hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: At an open V of the affine chart, restriction keeps the additive component at its image open. The overFunctorEquiv hom and inv components are identities on these additive sections, directly from their definitions. The fully faithful forgetful functor preimage is the sheaf morphism with exactly the original presheaf morphism as its val. The overEquiv functor evaluates this morphism at Over.mk of the image-open inclusion. The restrictFunctorComp hom and inv components are the presheaf maps along the equality of composite image opens. At top, compose these maps with the section equivalences chartSectionsEquiv, which are restrictAppIso followed by transport along fromSpec image top = U. Functoriality cancels the source and target equality transports. Naturality of the original over morphism along the unique isomorphism from the resulting terminal over object to Over.mk (identity U) identifies the component with phi.app(op(Over.mk(identity U))). Extensionality of linear maps concludes. Empty U needs no separate assumption: the same functoriality and terminal-object argument applies.
